question.wording: Is this payment one the instructions say can't be deducted — a political contribution, club or lodge dues, raffle, bingo or lottery tickets, tuition, the value of time or services, or a gift to an individual, a for-profit group, a foreign organization, a lobbying group, a civic league, social or sports club, labor union or chamber of commerce?

default.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this payment one the instructions say can't be deducted — a political contribution, club or lodge dues, raffle, bingo or lottery tickets, tuition, the value of time or services, or a gift to an individual, a for-profit group, a foreign organization, a lobbying group, a civic league, social or sports club, labor union or chamber of commerce?
